        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        m = sc.nextInt();

        long t = sc.nextLong();

                prevs = next[prevs];

import java.util.HashMap;

import java.util.Map;

public class G {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        Iterator<String> tokens = br.lines()
                .flatMap(line -> Arrays.stream(line.trim().split("\\s+")))
                .filter(token -> !token.isEmpty())
                .iterator();

        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int n = Integer.parseInt(tokens.next());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(tokens.next());
        int s = Integer.parseInt(tokens.next()) - 1;
        long t = Long.parseLong(tokens.next());

        while (t % n != 0) {
            s = advance(s, (int) (t % n), m, n);
            t--;
        }

        long cant = t / n;
        List<Integer> order = new ArrayList<>();
        Map<Integer, Integer> seen = new HashMap<>();

        while (cant > 0 && !seen.containsKey(s)) {
            seen.put(s, order.size());
            order.add(s);
            s = advanceFull(s, m, n);
            cant--;
        }

        if (cant > 0) {
            int start = seen.get(s);
            long cycleLen = order.size() - start;
            long total = cant % cycleLen;
            for (long i = 0; i < total; i++) {
                s = advanceFull(s, m, n);
            }
        }

        out.println(s + 1);
        out.flush();
    }

    static int advance(int s, int x, int m, int n) {
        if (s < m) {
            return (s + x) % n;
        }
        return (s + n - x) % n;
    }

    static int advanceFull(int s, int m, int n) {
        for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            s = advance(s, i, m, n);
        }
        return s;
    }
}

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class G {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        FastReader in = new FastReader();
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int n = in.nextInt();
        int m = in.nextInt();
        int s = in.nextInt() - 1;
        long t = in.nextLong();

        while (t % n != 0) {
            int x = (int) (t % n);
            s = apply(s, x, m, n);
            t--;
        }

        long cant = t / n;
        Map<Integer, Integer> next = new HashMap<>();

        while (cant > 0 && !next.containsKey(s)) {
            int before = s;
            s = applyAll(s, m, n);
            next.put(before, s);
            cant--;
        }

        if (cant > 0) {
            long cycle = 1;
            int p = next.get(s);
            while (p != s) {
                p = next.get(p);
                cycle++;
            }
            long rem = cant % cycle;
            while (rem-- > 0) {
                s = next.get(s);
            }
        }

        out.println(s + 1);
        out.flush();
    }

    static int apply(int s, int x, int m, int n) {
        if (s < m) {
            return (s + x) % n;
        }
        return (s + n - x) % n;
    }

    static int applyAll(int s, int m, int n) {
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
            if (s < m) {
                s = (s + i) % n;
            } else {
                s = (s + n - i) % n;
            }
        }
        return s;
    }

    static class FastReader {
        private BufferedReader br;
        private StringTokenizer st;

        FastReader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }
}
